cases.question: For locally funded schools whose K-12 minus ages-5-17 enrollment difference exceeds the average such difference among locally funded schools, list each school's directory-listed name and DOC type.

I'm assembling a Japanese-language boros deck and want to check which cards need careful rules review. For every card that has a boros watermark and a Japanese printing, please give me: the Japanese card name, the English card type, and the total number of official rulings recorded for that card. A card is identified by its Japanese name together with its English card type - printings that share both count as one card, and if either differs they should be listed as separate cards. The ruling total should add up all ruling entries across every printing of that card, and if a card has no rulings, list it with a total of 0.
cases.evidence: Boros watermark means the watermark is marked 'boros' on the card; a Japanese printing is the foreign data entry in Japanese; rulings are the official rules clarifications recorded for a card.

cases.question: Among the Commander-type expansion sets released in calendar year 2020 (1 January 2020 to 31 December 2020), I need the one with the highest total card count, so we can plan translation work. Please send me the set's id from the sets listing, its name, and the number of official languages it was released in. The total card count should include promotional and related supplemental products, but exclude Alchemy modifications. If two sets tie for the highest total card count, list each of them, ordered by set id ascending.
cases.evidence: Commander: a multiplayer expansion type of the game. Alchemy modifications: online-only variant versions of cards.

cases.question: What is the difference in percentage points between the 2010 and 2011 shares of all Student badges, taking the 2010 share minus the 2011 share?

I'm profiling how seasoned our Organizer badge holders in Germany are. Among the users who earned the Organizer badge and are based in Germany, how many had already earned 5 badges before they got the Organizer badge? Just the count, please. Note: "before" means strictly earlier - badges earned at the same moment as the Organizer badge don't count toward the 5, and the Organizer badge itself doesn't count as one of the 5.
cases.evidence: Organizer badge: the badge whose name is Organizer.

cases.question: I'm auditing accounts on the stats forum. What is the id of the youngest user account whose display name is Michael? If two or more such accounts tie as the youngest, give me the smallest id.

As part of a data-quality review for a segment report, I need to know how much of the recorded transaction activity for one of our segments has no payment purpose noted. How many transactions are there, over the whole recorded history, on the accounts held by male customers born between 1974 and 1976 (birth years 1974, 1975 and 1976), for which no payment purpose is noted? Please give me just that single number.
cases.evidence: Payment purpose: the stated reason or note recorded for a transaction.

cases.question: I'm putting together a review of our first credit card wave and need a profile of every client who was issued a credit card in 1994 (issue date falling in calendar year 1994). For each such client, please include: client id, gender, birth date, card type, age at card issue (the card's issue year minus the client's birth year), number of loans on their account, total amount borrowed, borrower classification, district name, district average salary, and their age rank within gender. Use these classifications: Young borrower if there's at least one loan on the account and age at card issue is under 30; Mature borrower if there's at least one loan and age at card issue is 30 or more; otherwise Non-borrower. The age rank within gender should be a standard competition rank - equal ages share a rank and the next rank is skipped (e.g. 1, 1, 3). Order the rows by client id.

I need to find out where our pre-1997 long-term mortgage exposure is concentrated geographically. Long-term means a loan duration of more than 24 months, and "opened before 1997" should exclude anything opened during 1997. Please tell me: for each region, which districts have at least one such account, and give me the region whose qualifying districts have the largest combined number of inhabitants. Along with the region's name, I want the number of those districts in it, their combined population, and the total number of those accounts in the region. If two regions tie on combined population, pick the one whose name comes first alphabetically.

For each year before 1975 with recorded winner times, what was the mean race winner elapsed time in seconds? Round the exact mean to two decimal places; if it is exactly halfway, round away from zero. Order by year.

Who won the 2017 Azerbaijan Grand Prix? I'd like the winner's forename and surname, the local clock time (hours:minutes:seconds.milliseconds) at the circuit at which he crossed the finish line, and the url of his information page, so I can compare the moment the race ended with the TV coverage.
cases.evidence: A driver's race time is the duration from the start of the race to the moment he crosses the finish line.

cases.question: I'm writing a piece about how the same common forenames recur across Formula 1 history. Could you tell me how many different drivers named Peter have ever won a Formula 1 race, and the same for drivers named John? Please give me one count per forename, so I can compare the two — if they turn out to be equal, just report both counts side by side. Nothing else needed.
cases.evidence: A race win means the driver finished first in that race.

cases.question: I'm reviewing our roster against the catalog and want to see how much of the College of Humanities and Social Sciences' coverage our members actually hold, department by department. For each department in that college, give me: the department's name, the majors it offers, the majors held by at least one of our members, and the average members per major it offers, rounded to two decimals. Membership is as currently listed in the member records, and count a department as belonging to the college when any of its majors sits in the college.
cases.evidence: College of Humanities and Social Sciences: one of the colleges that houses departments offering majors.

cases.question: What is the date of the Vice President's most recent expense on record, and what is the total cost of all expenses incurred on that date? Consider all expenses on record with no earlier cut-off, and give the total exactly as it appears in the records, without rounding.
cases.evidence: Vice President is a position of the Student Club.

cases.question: For every event in the club's records, can you give me the event name, event date, total amount budgeted for the event, and the number of members who attended it? Please sort the list by event name, then by event date, both in ascending order.
I'm preparing the year-end audit of club spending. For each item Sacha Harrison bought with club money, I need the item name and how many times she bought it. Can you give me that list?
cases.evidence: By "item" I mean an individual thing named in a record of what money was spent for.

cases.question: I'm putting together the end-of-term spending review. Who bought the most different kinds of items in October or November 2019? Please give me that member's full name, how many different kinds of items they bought in those two months, and their total spending in dollars over the same period. If two members tie for the most kinds, list every tied member with their kind count and spending.
cases.evidence: An item is one of the individual things a purchase covered, such as a pizza or a bottle of water.

cases.question: I'm writing an article about heroes who fall outside the classic good-versus-evil divide. How many superheroes in the database have an alignment that is neither good nor bad? Please give me just that count. Note that this should cover all superheroes in the database.
cases.evidence: good: a superhero whose alignment is Good; bad: a superhero whose alignment is Bad; alignment: the moral category assigned to a superhero

cases.question: I'm writing a piece about which real publishing companies have put out very tall heroes. How many publishers in the database have released at least one hero taller than 200 cm? Note that taller than 200 cm means strictly more than 200 cm, and it counts if even one of their heroes is that tall. I just need the number of publishers, nothing else.
cases.evidence: A hero's publisher being 'released' means the publisher the hero is attributed to in the database.

cases.question: For a licensing survey of non-DC heroic characters, I need a single total count of superheroes whose alignment is Good and who are not published by DC Comics. Just that one number, please.
cases.evidence: Good means the hero's alignment is Good; DC Comics means the publisher named DC Comics.

cases.question: I'm comparing how power-rich male and female heroes are. For all male heroes and all female heroes that have a documented real full name, what is the average number of superpowers per hero for each gender? Please compute each average over the entire hero population of that gender, not just the heroes that happen to have power records. Give me both averages, each rounded to two decimal places, and nothing else.
cases.evidence: Full name: the hero's real, full personal name (first name plus last name, and optionally middle names); single names such as mononyms or aliases are not a full name.

cases.question: I'm preparing a report on Marvel's roster and want to gauge how heroic their catalogued heroes are. Among Marvel Comics superheroes whose civilian full name is documented, what percentage are good? Please give me just that single percentage, rounded to two decimal places. Note: the percentage should be taken over all Marvel Comics superheroes with a known full name - those whose moral alignment is unknown still count toward the total, just not as good.
cases.evidence: Good refers to alignment = 'Good'. A full name means the hero's real-world civilian identity, i.e. an actual person's name such as 'Charles Chandler' or 'Richard Milhouse Jones'.

cases.question: Among superheroes whose weight is not recorded, how many more have the 'No Colour' eye category than have blue eyes? I want a single whole number: the count of 'No Colour' eyes minus the count of blue eyes in that group - it can be negative if blue is more common. Please give me just that one number, with no other results or breakdowns.
cases.evidence: 'No Colour' is an eye category meaning the hero's eye colour is unspecified.

cases.question: Among patients older than 55 on 2026-10-09 who have at least one abnormal PT result, what percentage are female? Round to two decimals.
cases.evidence: For this task, PT of at least 14 is abnormal.

cases.question: I'm studying patients who carry exactly the rheumatoid arthritis and Sjögren's syndrome overlap. Please look at each patient's own record and find those whose record names exactly rheumatoid arthritis and Sjögren's syndrome, in either order, and no other disease – a disease recorded only as suspected does not count as a diagnosis. For those patients, considering their whole recorded laboratory history regardless of date, I need two numbers: how many have had at least one laboratory result showing a normal platelet level, and how many have never had a laboratory result showing a normal platelet level – count a patient with no laboratory results at all as never having had a normal platelet result.
cases.evidence: Rheumatoid arthritis is recorded as the code RA and Sjögren's syndrome as the code SJS. A normal platelet level means a platelet count above 100 and below 400.

cases.question: I'm reviewing confirmed SLE cases for a study of neurologic involvement. Among patients whose examination lists SLE among the diagnosed diseases and who have a symptom recorded at such an examination, I need the case detail of the youngest such patient. Please send me the symptom recorded at that qualifying examination and that patient's overall diagnosis (their overall diagnosis, not the diagnosis written at the examination). If two patients share the same birth date, use the one with the smaller patient ID; and if that patient has more than one qualifying examination, use the most recent one.
cases.evidence: SLE is systemic lupus erythematosus. A disease name followed by 'susp' means the disease was only suspected, not diagnosed.

cases.question: For the carcinogenic molecules in the toxicology database, how many carbon-carbon bonds are there of each bond type (single, double, and triple)? Please give me the bond type and the corresponding count.
cases.evidence: A molecule labelled '+' is carcinogenic. Bond types are recorded as follows: a single bond as '-', a double bond as '=', and a triple bond as '#'. A carbon-carbon bond is a bond whose two bonded atoms are both carbon.
